text:
[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (a b: String) : String :=
let len := a.length;
let result := String.mk len '0';
for i in finset.range len do
  let ai := a.get (String.Pos.mk i);
  let bi := b.get (String.Pos.mk i);
  if ai ≠ bi then
    result := result.set i '1';
result
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma string_get_set_eq
(a: String)
(i: Fin a.length)
(c: Char)
: (a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = c) → (a.set i c = a) :=
by
simp [String.set]

lemma string_get_set_neq
(a: String)
(i: Fin a.length)
(c: Char)
(c': Char)
(h_c_neq_c': c ≠ c') :
(a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = c') → (a.set i c = a) :=
by
simp [String.set]

lemma string_get_get_eq
(a: String)
(i: Fin a.length)
: (a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = a.get (String.Pos.mk i)) :=
by
simp

lemma string_get_get_neq
(a: String)
(i: Fin a.length)
(i': Fin a.length)
(h_i_neq_i': i ≠ i')
: (a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = a.get (String.Pos.mk i')) →
(a.get (String.Pos.mk i) ≠ a.get (String.Pos.mk i')) :=
by
simp

lemma string_length_eq
(a: String)
: a.length = a.length :=
by
simp

lemma string_length_pos
(a: String)
: 0 < a.length → a.length > 0 :=
by
exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero

lemma string_length_nonneg
(a: String)
: 0 ≤ a.length :=
by
simp

lemma string_all_get_eq
(a: String)
(c: Char)
: a.all (fun c' => c' = c) → a = String.mk a.length c :=
by
induction' a
simp
rename_i a tail ih
by_cases h_a_char: a.head = c
simp [h_a_char] at ih
have h_tail_eq: tail = String.mk tail.length c := by
  simp [ih]
have h_all_eq: a = String.mk (a.length) c := by
  simp [h_a_char, h_tail_eq]
simp [h_all_eq]

lemma string_all_get_neq
(a: String)
(c: Char)
(c': Char)
(h_c_neq_c': c ≠ c')
: a.all (fun c' => c' = c) → a.all (fun c' => c' = c') → a = String.mk a.length c' →
a = String.mk a.length c :=
by
contradiction

lemma string_all_get_neq_char
(a: String)
(i: Fin a.length)
(c: Char)
(c': Char)
(h_c_neq_c': c ≠ c')
: a.all (fun c' => c' = c) → a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = c' →
a.get (String.Pos.mk i) ≠ c :=
by
simp

lemma string_all_get_neq_string
(a: String)
(i: Fin a.length)
(c: Char)
(c': Char)
(h_c_neq_c': c ≠ c')
: a.all (fun c' => c' = c) → a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = c' →
a = String.mk a.length c →
a.get (String.Pos.mk i) ≠ c :=
by
contrapose! h_c_neq_c'
exact h_c_neq_c'

lemma string_all_get_neq_fin
(a: String)
(i: Fin a.length)
(c: Char)
(c': Char)
(h_c_neq_c': c ≠ c')
: a.all (fun c' => c' = c) → a.get (String.Pos.mk i) = c' →
a.all (fun c' => c' = c') →
a = String.mk a.length c' →
a = String.mk a.length c →
a.get (String.Pos.mk i) ≠ c :=
by
contrapose! h_c_neq_c'
exact h_c_neq_c'

[END]
